title: STAR WARS ORIGAMI: 36 Amazing Paper-Folding Projects from a Galaxy Far Away 2012
descriptionText: The product is a paperback book titled "Star Wars Origami: 36 Amazing Paper-Folding Projects from a Galaxy Far, Far Away..." by Chris Alexander. Published by Workman Publishing in 2012, it features 36 paper-folding projects inspired by the Star Wars universe. The book is illustrated and includes 272 pages filled with origami instructions related to crafts, hobbies, and performing arts.
